Noah (People Ops): Hey all — quick live thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands re: remote/hybrid ops. Focus today: satellite hub access, travel windows, offsite childcare questions. Drop short Qs and we'll answer. Link to playbook: https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :wave:

Elena Ruiz: Can I get a recurring satellite pass for the Berlin coworking hub? I travel there 3x/month.

Noah (People Ops): Short answer: yes, we offer recurring satellite passes for high-frequency travelers. Submit a Satellite Pass request form (link in playbook) and we'll review monthly usage. If approved, tagging is `hub-recurring`.

Samir K.: Travel booking window question — what's the preferred lead time for international flights for offsites?

Noah (People Ops): Prefer 21+ days for international when possible to get best fares. If you must book last-minute, use the Travel Portal and note reason in the expense. For manager-approved exceptions (urgent customer work), add the manager's approval screenshot to the expense.

Hannah Lee: Offsite childcare — if I need to bring my child because daycare closes during our week-long offsite, is there any support?

Noah (People Ops): We don't cover personal childcare costs by default. For exceptional cases (e.g., no local daycare options), people-ops can approve a one-time childcare stipend — requires manager sign-off and submission before booking. DM me with details and dates.

PolicyBot: Policy update: Satellite pass approval flow revised 2025-06-01. See: https://intranet.redwood/policies/satellite-passes (automated notice).

Elena Ruiz: Expense coding — do we use `hub-recurring` or `hub-credit` for approved recurring passes?

Noah (People Ops): Use `hub-recurring` for approved recurring passes, `hub-credit` for ad-hoc single-day coworking. Always attach booking confirmation.

Samir K.: If my passport renewal overlaps the offsite, can I shift attendance to a later regional offsite instead?

Noah (People Ops): We can usually accommodate shifting to the next regional offsite or provide remote participation support (stipend + coworking credit). Email people-ops@redwood.com with dates and we'll coordinate with your manager.

Noah (People Ops): Quick example snippet to paste into the expense form:

```
Expense title: Berlin-SatellitePass-June
Amount: 120.00
Category: Travel - Hub Pass
Receipts: pass.pdf
Expense tag: hub-recurring
```

Noah (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll update the Workstyle playbook and pin a short FAQ here. If you need an invite letter or one-off approvals, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com :spiral_note_pad:
